As far as the merits of the Bail Application are concerned,
 the Applicant was arrested on 13th April 2021 and she is in  custody for almost 3 years.

As per the Charge-sheet, there are  about 31 witnesses proposed to be examined by the prosecution.
 As far as the stage of the trial is concerned, the Charge is framed  and Witness summons has been sent to P.W.-1, however, Charge-  sheet shows that about 31 witnesses are proposed to be examined  by the prosecution.
Therefore, the trial is likely to take a  considerably long time.
13. Statement of the victim under Section 164 of the Code of  Criminal Procedure, 1973 has also been recorded, the same  prima facie do not show involvement of the Applicant in the  crime.
